channel.title: frontier-wire

item.title: В угандийском королевстве спорят о короне из-за «тайного сына» / A "secret son" throws a Ugandan kingdom into a succession crisis
item.description: The late king's family has rejected the committee's chosen successor. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/10/uganda-king-secret-son-succession-dispute)

item.description: Half a century after a controversial computer proof, the theorem gets a fresh angle. (source: https://www.quantamagazine.org/the-four-color-theorem-gets-a-rare-new-proof-20260910/)

item.description: César de la Fuente's lab uses AI to mine genomes for antimicrobial candidates. (source: https://openai.com/index/using-codex-chatgpt-to-search-for-new-antimicrobials)

item.title: Инопланетную жизнь как будто нашли дважды — учёные в основном не верят / Alien life was "found" twice — most scientists still aren't convinced
item.description: A survey of astrobiologists shows 2025's headline claims convinced almost no one. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260909005212.htm)

item.title: Шноор в Бремене: квартал, будто сошедший со страниц сказки / The Schnoor: Bremen's storybook old quarter
item.description: The city's oldest district hides narrow lanes and crooked little houses. (source: https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/the-schnoor)

item.title: LinkedIn отбилась от исков о слежке за расширениями браузера / LinkedIn beats lawsuits over scanning users' browser extensions
item.description: A judge ruled plaintiffs failed to allege any real privacy violation. (source: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/09/linkedin-beats-browsergate-lawsuits-over-scanning-users-chrome-extensions/)

item.title: Верховный суд Бразилии досрочно закрылся на фоне политического хаоса / Brazil's Supreme Court shuts down early amid political chaos
item.description: Justices are publicly accusing each other after a bank scandal. (source: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/11/brazils-supreme-court-shuts-down-early-as-political-chaos-mounts?traffic_source=rss)

item.title: OpenAI выпустила GPT-6 Astra — и тут же выяснилось, как она устроена / OpenAI Ships GPT-6 Astra — and Someone Immediately Explained How It Works
item.description: OpenAI calls its new model the most capable one yet for business — but the real technical detail came from outside observers, not the announcement itself. (source: https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra-next-generation-work)

item.title: Apple наконец показала складной iPhone — и им же дебютирует новый гендиректор / Apple Finally Shows a Foldable iPhone — Also the New CEO's Debut
item.description: The $2,000 iPhone Duo folds like a passport and unfolds into a 7.6-inch screen — but it wasn't Tim Cook who announced it. (source: https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/09/apples-long-rumored-foldable-becomes-reality-with-the-2000-iphone-duo/)

item.title: Межзвёздная комета 3I/ATLAS оказалась залита метанолом / Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS Is Unexpectedly Drenched in Methanol
item.description: ALMA observations found exceptionally high methanol levels on a visitor from another star system — a hint it formed under different conditions than typical comets. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260909005217.htm)

item.title: Телескоп «Чандра» нашёл рентгеновские объекты, которые не укладываются ни в одну известную категорию / Chandra Finds X-Ray Objects That Don't Fit Any Known Category
item.description: Astronomers describe a new class of X-ray sources in other galaxies — and hope it could help settle two long-standing astrophysics puzzles at once. (source: https://science.nasa.gov/missions/chandra/nasas-chandra-unveils-mysterious-x-ray-objects/)

item.title: У берегов Филиппин сгорел паром со 134 пассажирами и членами экипажа на борту / A Ferry Carrying 134 People Caught Fire Off the Philippines
item.description: The vessel caught fire near the tourist destination of Palawan; there are confirmed deaths and dozens still missing. (source: https://www.dw.com/en/philippines-several-killed-dozens-missing-after-fire-on-ferry/a-79208236?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf)

item.title: В Китае юристы и архитекторы подрабатывают, обучая ИИ своей же профессии / In China, Lawyers and Architects Are Gig-Training the AI That Studies Their Own Jobs
item.description: A stagnant economy and state directives are pushing skilled professionals into cheap gig work — teaching AI systems the trades they built careers on. (source: https://restofworld.org/2026/china-expert-ai-trainers/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=feeds)

item.title: «Монастырь десяти тысяч Будд» в Гонконге — это не монастырь, и Будд там больше 12 000 / Hong Kong's 'Ten Thousand Buddhas Monastery' Isn't a Monastery, and Has More Than 12,000 Buddhas
item.description: The name is a double misnomer: no monks live there, and the statue count runs well past the advertised ten thousand. (source: https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/ten-thousand-buddhas-monastery)

item.title: Дрон едва не столкнулся с самолётом Зеленского на пути в Осло / A Drone Nearly Hit Zelenskyy's Plane En Route to Oslo
item.description: Norway's PM reported the incident on the Moldova-to-Oslo route; a Ukrainian source says the threat may have been overstated. (source: https://www.dw.com/en/norway-s-pm-zelenskyy-s-plane-almost-hit-by-drone/a-79207528?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf)

item.title: Уганда вышла из Игр Инвиктус «из уважения к королю Карлу» / Uganda Pulls Out of the Invictus Games 'Out of Respect for King Charles
item.description: The country's military chief announced the move on X, citing division over "this Harry-Meghan nonsense. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/09/uganda-withdraws-invictus-games-out-of-respect-king-charles)

item.title: Учёные нашли «переключатель» роста костей, способный побороть остеопороз / Scientists Find a Bone-Building Switch That Could Fight Osteoporosis
item.description: The experimental compound AP503 significantly strengthened bones in mice by activating the GPR133 receptor — and appears to help muscles too. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260909005305.htm)

item.title: У детей матерей с анемией при рождении мозг оказался меньше / Babies Born to Anaemic Mothers Have Smaller Brains, Study Finds
item.description: Regions linked to movement, learning and emotion were affected, and researchers warn this may lead to cognitive problems. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/sep/09/babies-born-to-anaemic-mothers-have-smaller-brains-study-finds)

item.title: Собор в Белизе, который построили, чтобы приструнить бывших пиратов / The Belize Cathedral Britain Built to Rein In Ex-Pirates
item.description: St. John's Anglican Cathedral in Belize City was built in 1812 by enslaved labor, using local mahogany and brick brought over as ship's ballast. (source: https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/saint-john-anglican-cathedral)

item.title: Синдаров обыграл Фирузджу и вывел свою команду в лидеры Global Chess League / Sindarov Beats Firouzja to Give His Team the Global Chess League Lead
item.description: A second straight win for the Uzbek grandmaster put American Gambits in first place, while Triveni Continental Kings slid to the bottom of the table. (source: https://www.chess.com/news/view/2026-tech-mahindra-global-chess-league-day-5)

item.title: «Один симптом, три рычага»: свежая работа ставит под сомнение модный метод дообучения ИИ / One symptom, three levers": a new paper questions a trendy way to fine-tune AI models
item.description: A new arXiv paper takes apart on-policy self-distillation, a popular way to fine-tune language models on their own output, and promises to trace its problems to one shared symptom and three possible fixes. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.25936)

item.title: Учёные учат нейросети находить изменения на спутниковых снимках — не хватает самих снимков / Scientists are teaching AI to spot change in satellite images — the real bottleneck is the images themselves
item.description: A new paper proposes generating synthetic before-and-after satellite image pairs guided by real-world knowledge instead of handwritten rules, to train models that track change on Earth's surface. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.24263)

item.title: OpenAI заявила, что ИИ решил задачу Навье — Стокса за миллион долларов. Математики спорят, кому это засчитывать / OpenAI says an AI solved the $1 million Navier-Stokes problem. Mathematicians are arguing over who gets credit
item.description: An unreleased OpenAI model and 10,000 AI agents reportedly cracked one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems in 88 hours — and immediately triggered a fight over credit. (source: https://www.quantamagazine.org/ai-has-solved-one-of-maths-1-million-millennium-prize-problems-20260908/)

item.title: Глава Смитсоновского института уходит в отставку после 38 лет службы / The head of the Smithsonian Institution is stepping down after 38 years
item.description: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie G. Bunch III has announced his retirement — a career at the institution that began in the 1970s and whose biggest legacy is the National Museum of African American History and Culture. (source: https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smithsonian-institution/secretary-lonnie-bunch-announces-retirement-head-smithsonian-38-years-service-institution-180989460/)

item.title: Из французского музея Ренуара похитили картины на 2,5 миллиона долларов — двое из четырёх грабители обронили при побеге / Thieves stole $2.5 million in Renoir paintings from a French museum — then dropped half of them while fleeing
item.description: Burglars took four paintings from the Renoir Museum on the French Riviera and dropped two of them during their escape. (source: https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/thieves-broke-into-a-french-museum-and-made-off-with-renoir-paintings-worth-more-than-25-million-180989462/)

item.title: В Китае юристы, архитекторы и инженеры подрабатывают, обучая ИИ собственной профессии / In China, lawyers, architects, and engineers are moonlighting to teach AI their own professions
item.description: Amid a sluggish economy and state directives, underemployed Chinese professionals are taking cheap gig work teaching AI the expertise of their own trades — just to cover the mortgage. (source: https://restofworld.org/2026/china-expert-ai-trainers/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=feeds)

item.title: Учёные нашли в крови гремучих змей белки, которые нейтрализуют яд в 10 раз эффективнее нынешних антидотов / Scientists found proteins in rattlesnake blood that neutralize venom 10 times more effectively than current antidotes
item.description: Combinations of toxin-blocking proteins from rattlesnake blood outperformed a commercial antivenom in lab tests — and worked against venom from several dangerous species at once. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260907201605.htm)

item.title: Microsoft закрыла рекордные 972 уязвимости за один патч-вторник — 112 из них критические / Microsoft just patched a record 972 vulnerabilities in one Patch Tuesday — 112 of them critical
item.description: Ars Technica calls the latest Microsoft update batch a "doozy" — the biggest patch volume on record, driven partly by the threat of AI-assisted attacks. (source: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/09/microsoft-patches-a-record-972-vulnerabilities-112-of-them-critical/)

item.title: Марсоход Curiosity отметил 5000 марсианских дней на Марсе — и стал заодно рекордным «альпинистом» / NASA's Curiosity rover just logged 5,000 Martian days on Mars — and became a record-setting climber along the way
item.description: NASA's latest Curiosity mission blog says the rover has passed 5,000 sols on Mars — and along the way climbed higher than any other Mars rover has gone. (source: https://science.nasa.gov/blog/curiosity-blog-sols-4995-5001-5000-martian-days-on-mars/)

item.title: Конфеты у детей, брызгозащищённые писсуары и закопанные трусы: назвали лауреатов Игнобелевской премии 2026 года / Stealing candy from kids, splash-proof urinals, and buried underwear win the 2026 Ig Nobel Prizes
item.description: Smithsonian Magazine rounds up this year's Ig Nobel Prize winners — the spoof award for real research that's funny first and thought-provoking second. (source: https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/stealing-candy-from-children-splash-proof-urinals-and-buried-panties-oh-my-here-are-the-winners-of-the-2026-ig-nobel-prizes-180989463/)

item.title: Под стройплощадкой в Бразилии нашли нового гигантского динозавра ростом с шестиэтажный дом / A new giant dinosaur turned up beneath a construction site in Brazil — as long as a city block
item.description: Scientists have described a newly identified dinosaur roughly 20 meters long that lived 120 million years ago — and found an unexpected evolutionary link to a dinosaur from Spain. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260907201603.htm)

item.title: Ураган «Лоуэлл» обрушился на западные острова Гавайев — без света осталось 91% одного из островов / Hurricane Lowell slams Hawaii's western islands, knocking out power to 91% of one island
item.description: Hurricane Lowell battered Hawaii with damaging winds, heavy rain, and flooding and is pushing further into the Pacific, having knocked out power to nearly all of one western island. (source: https://phys.org/news/2026-09-hurricane-lowell-lashes-hawaii-western.html)

item.title: Телевизоры LG уличили в сканировании домашней сети в поисках чужих телефонов и устройств / LG TVs caught scanning home networks for other people's phones and devices
item.description: Ars Technica reports on a demonstration showing LG televisions scanning the local network for other devices — and, apparently, capable of tracking user activity even while offline. (source: https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/09/lg-tv-shown-capable-of-tracking-user-activity-even-when-offline/)

item.title: «Водяной вор»: как древнегреческая клепсидра почти 1800 лет была самым точным способом измерить время / The "water thief": how an ancient Greek water clock stayed the most accurate way to measure time for 1,800 years
item.description: Open Culture traces the history of the clepsydra — ancient Greece's water clock, with roots reaching back at least to the 16th century BCE. (source: https://www.openculture.com/2026/09/the-ancient-greek-water-clock-that-kept-the-most-accurate-time-for-1800-years.html)

item.title: Microsoft выложил инструмент, который превращает офисные файлы в Markdown — и тот мгновенно попал в тренды GitHub / Microsoft's tool that turns office files into Markdown just shot up GitHub's trending list
item.description: The markitdown repo climbed to #2 on today's GitHub trending list with 771 stars in a day — a familiar pattern for tools that prep documents for AI pipelines. (source: https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown)

item.title: HeyGen выпустил инструмент, который пишет HTML и получает на выходе видео — специально для ИИ-агентов / HeyGen built a tool that writes HTML and renders it as video — made for AI agents
item.description: The hyperframes repo topped today's GitHub trending list with 734 stars in a day — an agent writes HTML markup, and the tool renders it straight into video. (source: https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes)

item.title: Контекст ИИ-агента раздувается — новый инструмент обещает сократить его на 98% / AI agents are drowning in context — a new tool claims a 98% cut
item.description: The context-mode repo landed at #3 on today's GitHub trending list — it sandboxes an agent's tool output and claims a 98% cut in what ends up in the context window, across 17 platforms. (source: https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode)

item.title: Исследователи научили ИИ понимать речь и видео вместе — без дообучения моделей / Researchers get AI to understand speech and video together without retraining a thing
item.description: A new paper links speech, on-screen events, and their timing using off-the-shelf, "frozen" vision-language models — with no additional training at all. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2609.04242)

item.title: Аватар, который говорит и одновременно двигается: одна модель вместо двух / An avatar that talks and moves at once — from one model, not two
item.description: A new paper called Motion-Omni merges speech generation and full-body motion for a talking avatar into a single model — a job previously split across separate systems. (source: https://huggingface.co/papers/2609.04250)

item.title: В трендах GitHub — «невидимый» браузер для ИИ-агентов, который умеет обходить Cloudflare / GitHub's trending list has a "stealth" browser built for AI agents — one that gets past Cloudflare
item.description: The camofox-browser repo landed at #4 on today's GitHub trending list with 285 stars in a day — a headless browser built to look like a regular user to anti-bot systems. (source: https://github.com/jo-inc/camofox-browser)
